verses.1: And you shall bring to me your brother Aaron and his sons from among the children of Israel, so that they may be priests for me. These are Aaron’s sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.2: And you made sacred garments for your brother Aaron, for honor and for glory.
verses.3: And you shall speak to all those who are wise in heart, who are filled with the spirit of wisdom. They will make Aaron’s garments holy for him, so that he may serve as a priest.
verses.4: And these are the offerings that should be made: incense, fragrant spices, and other offerings. They were also made from woven cloth for Aaron and his sons as offerings to be used as priests.
verses.5: And they will take the gold, the utensils, and the altar. They will also take the second lampstand and the seven lamps.
verses.6: And they made the Ephod of gold; its chest and its bag were also made of gold. There were also six pins made from gold as decorations.
verses.7: Two of the branches will be given to him; they will belong to his two ends and branches.
verses.8: And he thought of his downfall; from what he did, gold will be made into tools and instruments. And there will also be rings and bracelets made of gold.
verses.9: And you took two stones from Shechem, and you wrote names of the Israelites on them.
verses.10: Six names are written on one of the stones, and the names of the six remaining names are written on the second stone. They were written down at that time.
verses.11: He will make a hole in the stone, and he will open both stones. These stones will be used as seals for the descendants of Israel. They will be made from gold.
verses.12: And you shall place the two stones on the shoulders of the Ark. These are stones that remind us of Israel’s ancestors. Aaron will write their names on them before Jehovah’s altar, on the shoulders of the Ark, as a reminder.
verses.14: And two pure gold bracelets shall be made from the materials required for this purpose. Then, the impure bracelets shall be placed on the pedestals.
verses.15: And you shall make a crown of gold, as a wise decision. It will be made of gold, brass, copper, and other metals. It will also include two kinds of jewels and six kinds of decorations.
verses.16: It will be a combination of long and wide strands.
verses.17: And fill it with four units of stone. One unit of stone is equivalent to one man’s worth. And the other unit of stone is used for the altar.
verses.18: And the second trumpet shall sound, and Yaelolom shall be destroyed.
verses.19: And the third trumpet will go forth, and it will bring destruction upon them.
verses.20: And the fourth throne will be adorned with golden decorations.
verses.21: And the stones will be marked with names of the Israelites. There will be twelve stones marked with their names. Each person’s name will be written on one of these stones.
verses.22: And you made a crown from gold. It was a beautiful creation.
verses.23: And you made two gold ornaments for the chashen. You placed those ornaments at both ends of the chashen.
verses.24: And you placed two heavy gold weights on each of the two poles.
verses.25: And these two ends of the ropes shall be placed on the two poles. They were also placed on the shoulders of the altar, right in front of its face.
verses.26: And you made two golden pedestals, and you placed them at the two ends of the altar, on its feet, which were located beyond the entrance to the temple.
verses.27: And you made two golden crowns, and you placed them on the two shoulders of the Ephod. This was done so that the Ephod could be worn from above the face down.
verses.28: And they will wrap the rope around its ends, so that it can be placed on top of the pole. In this way, the rope will remain secure on the pole, and the rope won’t fall off from the pole.
verses.29: And Aaron would take the names of the children of Israel into his heart, as a reminder before God. He would do this every time he went to the Holy Place.
verses.30: And you gave to Hoshanah the lights and the torches. They were placed on Aaron’s heart when he went before Jehovah. And Aaron carried the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart, always before Jehovah.
verses.31: And you made the covering for the Ephod completely perfect.
verses.32: And his mouth will be inside him; there will be a noise around it. It will be like a noise from something that is being made. It will not be able to be stopped.
verses.33: And you made on its sides shelves for storing goods, as well as boxes and containers. Around its sides, there were also golden ornaments.
verses.34: Gold and silver are used to cover the edges of the covering.
verses.35: And it shall be that Ahron will serve as a priest. His voice shall be heard when he goes before Jehovah, and also when he returns from his duties. And he shall not die.
verses.36: And you made a pure gold shrine, and you inscribed on it the sacred seals of Jehovah.
verses.37: And you shall place it on the pole of the tent. It will be placed on top of the tent, right above its front edge.
verses.38: And it shall be upon the head of Aaron; and Aaron shall carry the offerings that the Israelites sanctify for all their sacred rituals. And his head shall always be a desire to them before Jehovah.
verses.39: And you made the text into six parts. You also created six separate sections, and each of them was given a specific purpose for its use.
verses.40: And the doors of Aaron’s house shall be made into decorations. You shall also make decorations for them, along with decorations for their rooms, so that they may be beautiful and ornate.
verses.41: And you shall bless them, along with your brother Aaron and their sons. You shall sanctify them, and make them holy for me.
verses.42: And make for them a covering that covers from their heads to their feet, so that they may be protected from their enemies.
verses.43: And they shall be upon Aaron and his sons when they go into the Tabernacle, or when they enter the altar to serve in the Holy Place. They shall not bear any shame or death. This is a forever law for him and his descendants.
